{"consolidated_memory":"SPURIOUS 429 ERRORS IN API GATEWAY RATE LIMITER - THREE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involved api/gateway/rate_limit.go (api gateway side). Stack: Go. Test coverage: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go. Common signal across all incidents: throttle counters far above the configured ceiling. Reproduction method for all: replay the saved burst fixture.

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-19]
Scope: Affected tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root Cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR: #2936 on branch fix/spurious-429-1
Outcome: Job finished in 70 minutes instead of 4 hours

---

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-17]
Scope: Affected only the staging read replica
Root Cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation
Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
PR: #5114 on branch fix/spurious-429-2
Outcome: Reclaimed 61 GB of blob storage

---

INCIDENT 3 [2026-09-01]
Scope: Affected jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root Cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR: #5834 on branch fix/spurious-429-3
Outcome: Error rate dropped from 6.6 percent to under 6 per ten thousand"}
